'''2012 European Championship Darren Malins DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Darren Malins]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
